package.name: openral_hal_openarm
package.description: Real-hardware bringup for the Enactic OpenArm v2 bimanual arm: a thin include of upstream openarm_bringup's ros2_control graph on the real CAN bus, plus the pinned vendor deps.repos and patches. The OpenArm HAL node itself is the generic openral_hal_node; robots/openarm/robot.yaml reaches this launch through hal.real_bringup.
